title: Remote Work Top Workplace: MicroHealth Named National Winner
summary: MicroHealth earns Remote Work Top Workplace recognition for the third year, reflecting its people-first culture and employee-driven success.
body_markdown:
By **Trinity Cyrus** | Oct 6, 2025


Vienna, Virginia – MicroHealth LLC, a leading Information Technology company, has once again earned national recognition as a Remote Work Top Workplace. The company ranked 13th in the nation on the 2025 list published by[Energage](https://www.energage.com/) . This is MicroHealth’s[third consecutive year](https://www.microhealthllc.com/news/microhealth-earns-second-top-remote-workplace-honor/) receiving this honor. The award is based on the independent Energage employee engagement survey.


### Recognition Built on Intention and People


Being named a Remote Work Top Workplace is more than a ranking. It shows MicroHealth’s[intentional culture](https://www.microhealthllc.com/about-us/) focused on[people](https://www.microhealthllc.com/careers/lifeat/) and performance.


“As one of our team members shared, ‘At MicroHealth, I am empowered to be my best,’” said Kumud “K” Sharma,[Head of Human Resources.](https://www.microhealthllc.com/about-us/our-team/) “This recognition reflects our commitment to supporting employees so they can deliver meaningful results for[our clients.](https://www.microhealthllc.com/clients/) ”


### Putting People First, Always


MicroHealth’s people-first approach includes flexible work options. The company provides remote, hybrid, and in-office options, helping team members balance work with what matters most to them.


The company also offers a[comprehensive benefits](https://www.microhealthllc.com/careers/) package starting day one. These benefits include:


- 11 paid holidays


- 5–40 hours of paid personal leave


- 10–25 days of paid time off


- Health coverage, tuition reimbursement, and wellness resources


This investment in employees helps position MicroHealth as an employer of choice in the federal IT space.


### Real Voices, Real Impact


What makes this award especially meaningful is that it comes directly from employees. Energage’s confidential survey measures engagement and organizational health, providing an authentic view of how team members experience life at MicroHealth.


Earning this honor three years in a row reflects MicroHealth’s continued investment in remote work best practices, including:


- Implementing smart virtual collaboration tools that keep teams connected and productive


- Maintaining a strong, people-first culture that extends across distributed teams


- Providing resources and support systems to help employees thrive in remote environments


### About the Award


Energage is a purpose-driven organization that helps companies build strong employer brands. It conducts the Top Workplaces program each year.


Now in its 18th year, the program recognizes organizations nationally and in more than 60 regional markets.


The Remote Work Top Workplaces award specifically honors companies that create strong people-first cultures for remote teams.


“Earning a Top Workplaces award is a badge of honor,” said Eric Rubino, Energage CEO. “It comes authentically from employees. That is something to be proud of. Leaders must ensure employees have a voice and are heard. Top Workplaces do this, and it pays dividends.”


### **Now that we have your attention**


MicroHealth is a service-disabled, Veteran-owned small business making a BIG impact in


[federal IT](https://www.microhealthllc.com/clients/) . From


[agile project management](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/agile-project-management/) and


[advanced cybersecurity](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/devops/) to


[generative AI](https://www.microhealthllc.com/) ,


[data analytics](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/data-analytics/) ,


[software development](https://www.microhealthllc.com/solutions/software-development/) , and more, we deliver secure, innovative solutions for government agencies and the Uniformed Services.


We’re proud to be a five-time Top Workplace USA winner. See more of our awards at
